mapper.sql: C.CLM_NO, C.ORD_NO, C.CLM_TYPE, C.CLM_STAT, C.CLM_RSN, C.CLM_RSN_DTL, C.RTN_FEE, C.RTN_FEE_PAYER, C.REFUND_AMT, C.REFUND_PNT_AMT, TO_CHAR(C.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REQ_DT, TO_CHAR(C.COL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS COL_DT, TO_CHAR(C.CMPL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CMPL_DT, C.REJ_RSN, C.REG_ID, C.UPD_ID

, (SELECT CD_NM FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'CLM_TYPE' AND CD = C.CLM_TYPE) AS CLM_TYPE_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'CLM_STAT' AND CD = C.CLM_STAT) AS CLM_STAT_NM , (SELECT CD_NM FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'CLM_RSN' AND CD = C.CLM_RSN) AS CLM_RSN_NM , DECODE(C.RTN_FEE_PAYER, 'C', '고객', 'S', '판매자', '') AS RTN_FEE_PAYER_NM
mapper.select: SELECT I.CLM_NO, I.ORD_NO, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRD_CD, P.PRD_NM, I.QTY, I.ITEM_AMT, I.CPN_DC_SHARE_AMT, I.REFUND_AMT FROM TB_CLM_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TB_PRD P ON P.PRD_CD = I.PRD_CD WHERE I.CLM_NO = #{clmNo} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ

SELECT
FROM TB_CLM C WHERE C.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY C.CLM_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLM ( CLM_NO, ORD_NO, CLM_TYPE, CLM_STAT, CLM_RSN, CLM_RSN_DTL, RTN_FEE, RTN_FEE_PAYER, REFUND_AMT, REFUND_PNT_AMT, REQ_DT, REG_ID) VALUES ( #{CLM_NO}, #{ORD_NO}, #{CLM_TYPE}, #{CLM_STAT}, #{CLM_RSN}, #{CLM_RSN_DTL}, NVL(#{RTN_FEE}, 0), #{RTN_FEE_PAYER}, 0, 0, SYSDATE, #{REG_ID})
INSERT INTO TB_CLM_ITEM (CLM_NO, ORD_NO, ITEM_SEQ, PRD_CD, QTY, ITEM_AMT, CPN_DC_SHARE_AMT, REFUND_AMT) VALUES (#{CLM_NO}, #{ORD_NO}, #{ITEM_SEQ}, #{PRD_CD}, #{QTY}, #{ITEM_AMT}, 0, 0)
